children: , the mission-driven restaurant brand serving healthy food at scale, is bringing its first-ever Jacksonville location to 4624 Town Crossing Dr. in St. Johns Town Center on September 15. The restaurant marks sweetgreen’s first location in Northeast Florida, with opening-day celebrations featuring local partnerships, special offerings and a chance to win a custom surfboard.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:

Open daily from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m., the 2,560-square-foot restaurant will offer sweetgreen's signature menu of chef-crafted salads, warm bowls and protein-forward plates. In addition to fan favorites like the Crispy Rice Bowl and Miso Glazed Salmon, guests can explore sweetgreen’s newest menu innovations, including its lineup of wraps, which bring the brand’s signature ingredients into a more portable format, and the limited-time Fall Harvest menu, featuring the seasonal-favorite Autumn Harvest Bowl and two new seasonal offerings: the Maple Glazed Salmon plate and Roasted Bacon Brussels side.

sweetgreen's commitment to high-quality, sustainably sourced ingredients is reflected throughout the restaurant experience. From the open kitchen, where meals are prepared fresh daily, to the source board showcasing the farmers and growers behind its ingredients, every detail brings the brand's farm-to-fork mission to life.
In Jacksonville, sweetgreen is partnering with

, a family-run grower with roots in Florida and a strong focus on sustainable farming, and Lady Moon farms, a family-owned, 100% organic grower that has been farming organically since 1988, to help bring ingredients from our growers and suppliers to the St. Johns Town Center restaurant.

“Jacksonville marks an exciting milestone for sweetgreen as we make our debut in Northeast Florida and bring our mission to a brand-new market,” said Ryan Slemons, Chief Development Officer at sweetgreen. “With its active lifestyle and appreciation for fresh, quality food, Jacksonville is a natural fit for us. We’re excited to finally open our doors in the River City and look forward to getting to know the community and becoming a part of it.”
Ahead of opening day, guests are invited to RSVP via Eventbrite for a sneak peek and complimentary meal on September 11 and 12.

To celebrate the grand opening on Tuesday, September 15, sweetgreen will host a special event starting at 10:00 a.m. featuring local partnerships and giveaways, while supplies last. Event details include:

sweetgreen is proud to partner with Clara White Mission, a Jacksonville-based non-profit committed to preventing and reducing homelessness. For every meal purchased on opening day, sweetgreen will donate a meal to Clara White Mission to nourish communities in Jacksonville experiencing food insecurity.

Orders can be placed in-restaurant, online or through the sweetgreen app, where guests can join SG Rewards. Members earn 10 points for every eligible dollar spent, unlocking personalized offers, exclusive perks and free menu favorites. Get all the details about SG Rewards here.
To learn more about sweetgreen Jacksonville, its menu and its loyalty program, visit www.sweetgreen.com and follow @sweetgreen on Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok and YouTube.
About sweetgreen:

sweetgreen (NYSE: SG) is on a mission to build healthier communities by connecting people to real food. Since 2007, the brand has reimagined what quick, accessible food can be: fresh, flavorful and built on real relationships with growers. From regional farms to kitchens across the country, sweetgreen serves seasonal, chef-crafted menus across more than 285 locations nationwide, creating spaces where food, people, and purpose come together.
